page: Microsoft Azure EC48as_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the ECasv6 family and managed under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is built on an x86_64 AMD processor architecture and provides 48 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory is sized at 384.0 GB, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio that provides high memory density relative to compute allocation.

Hardware configurations for the EC48as_v6 omit local storage drives and discrete GPU accelerators entirely. Storage operations require network-attached storage architectures, with native compatibility for Azure Premium Storage. The instance configuration also provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires network traffic to be routed through virtual networks or allocated public IP addresses.

By delivering an expansive memory footprint without bundled local disks, the instance provides cost efficiency for environments that rely on centralized remote block storage. Primary workloads for this configuration include in-memory databases, large caching layers, relational database management systems, big data analytics engines, and enterprise data processing applications that require substantial memory capacity.
